nodes.description: Public address state variable owner; set in constructor and used as the authorization whitelist by the restricted modifier.
Public uint state variable tracking the last completed migration; written by setCompleted and read by upgrade.
Constructor Migrations() that assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing the initial privileged account.
restricted function setCompleted(uint completed) that writes the supplied value into last_completed_migration.
restricted function upgrade(address new_address) that instantiates an arbitrary Migrations contract and calls setCompleted on it.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and for the restricted modifier authorization check.
uint parameter completed of setCompleted; value stored into last_completed_migration.
address parameter new_address of upgrade; user-supplied target used to build the external Migrations instance.
External call upgraded.setCompleted(...) on a caller-supplied contract address; executes untrusted code and can reenter or manipulate state.
Local Migrations instance created from new_address and used as the receiver of the external setCompleted call.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns the untrusted msg.sender directly to the privileged owner state variable.
restricted modifier gates setCompleted on the condition msg.sender == owner.
restricted modifier gates upgrade on the condition msg.sender == owner.
owner state variable is read by the restricted modifier that guards setCompleted.
owner state variable is read by the restricted modifier that guards upgrade.
The completed parameter is written into last_completed_migration.
upgrade performs an external call that transfers control to code at a caller-controlled address.
new_address parameter flows into the construction of the contract that is externally called.
last_completed_migration is read and passed as the argument of the external setCompleted call.
The local upgraded instance derived from new_address is the receiver of the external call.
The external call may invoke setCompleted on an untrusted contract, enabling reentrant or unauthorized state writes.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter completed is only a transient input to setCompleted and has no independent security meaning once merged into the function that consumes it.
new_address exists solely to determine the target of the external call, so it is folded into the unsafe operation node.
The local variable upgraded is merely the call receiver holding no persistent state and is absorbed into the external-call unsafe operation.
